118362.overview:
Bloody Fun Day is a puzzle Flash game developed by Urban Squall and published by Kongregate on March 12, 2009. Players control one of a family of three grim reapers and are tasked with moving around an island of hexagonal tiles, killing creatures called Cuties in order to replenish their own life force. Cuties come in four colors. Only the red ones restore life; the others charge special abilities that give the player more ways to kill further Cuties.

The game was initially developed as a demo by Urban Squall during the group's annual development meeting, in a San Diego hotel during November 2008. The demo was further tested after the five-day meeting, resulting in the complete game being released during March. The game's theme was inspired by the short story Everything Can Be Beaten by Jhonen Vasquez, which features a monster that clubs animals to death and is unable to interact with them in any other way.

Critics praised the game's concept, gameplay and addictiveness. The intensity of trying to keep the reaper alive was highlighted by some reviewers, such as saving the reaper's life by killing a large number of Cuties. Some issues, such as the lack of special effects and enemies, were highlighted; this did not prevent reviewers from rating the game positively overall.

139184.overview: BeGone is online multiplayer first person/third person shooter with a realistic theme. Players choose team and face off against each other in a modern battlefield using modern weapons. Each team tries to eliminate the opposing team before time runs out. Multiplayer aspect of the game lets players use teamwork, different strategy and tactics. The game features multiple weapons & grenades, virtual economy & bonuses, gameplay customization. It delivers immersive FPS online game action for free and is quickly accessible with no signup required.

139831.overview: Here is the fourth game of Boxhead game series. This version gives us a chance of playing this game with 2 players. You can play this game as multiplayer by choosing "Cooperative" from the game menu. Now, you can battle against to Zombies with your friend.

151543.overview:
Hit the park for some extreme BMX action! Ride, jump, tailwhip, backflip and superman to score the most points during the time limit.

You have 90 seconds to earn as many points as possible. You can do this by doing backflips, 360s, tailwhips and nothing. The BMX park is fairly big, allowing you to do tricks in many different areas. If you chain tricks together you will earn more points than you would usually, but you must be sure to land them or else your points will go to waste! It is best if you look at the controls before trying to set a high score!

151871.overview: In this clone of Puzzle Bobble/Bust-a-Move your goal is to clear all the bubbles before they overflow the board. Use your mouse to aim and shoot bubbles in this game, have fun!

156106.overview:
Fly 
Enter Code
Be a Bullet Bill



Giga Bill 8E7UC

169240.overview: Bloons is a video game franchise developed by Ninja Kiwi. The games involve players using monkeys, armed with various weapons, to pop as many "bloons" (balloons) as possible. They include the Bloons series, the Bloons Tower Defense series, and several other spin-offs. Most Bloons games are browser-based games that use Adobe Flash Player, although some are available on other platforms. The mobile games are now distributed through the App Store.

218763.overview:
Bloons TD 5 Flash is a Bloons Tower Defense game that was officially released on December 15, 2011 (December 13 for Ninja Kiwi accounts). 

Bloons TD 5 Flash was continually updated from the initial release date until the end of December 2018, as Flash was beginning to become retired at the end of 2020.

419001.overview:
Blaseball is baseball at your mercy. Baseball perfected. Our players are inhuman. They play day and night. Rain or shine. They never grow sick. They never tire.

This is our gift to you - the Fans. We hear your prayers at trade deadlines. We suffer your DH debates. No more. Democracy returns to the national pastime. Each week, you vote to remake the league in your own image. Everything from rules to rosters is in your hands.

During each week the game is active, a full season and championship series of "Internet League Blaseball" is simulated, with elections on Sundays in which the community can change the rules of the game. Non-player characters, such as the league's owner or commissioner, occasionally deliver dialogue on the website and through Twitter accounts, creating an absurdist horror narrative.

422585.overview: The game is about guiding the ball to the exit of a level. Note that the ball dies if it hits obstacles.

422616.overview:
Blacksmith Lab, also known as Blacksmith Clicker, is an idle business game developed by AUM Games and published in February 2016. It is also available on iOS.

In this game, the player must collect a variety of different precious materials such as iron, copper, and gold. They can start by building a store of iron by simply clicking on the iron deposit - as they collect iron, they can then start building items such as an iron shield. Once they start earning money, they can purchase upgrades to improve the rate at which they collect iron. As the player progresses, they can unlock new materials and earn a higher income.

422617.overview:
Boss Rush Apocalypse is a 2D fighting game developed by Dustin Auxier.

This game was made in three days for the indiesvspewdiepie game jam in November 2014.

422618.overview:
The Blind Swordsman is an action game programmed by Evil-Dog and published on Newgrounds on April 1, 2014.

In this game, the player controls the blind swordsman and they are on a quest to get their sight back. They have to fight countless enemies and find new skills.

422619.overview: Bubble Tanks 2 is the sequel to Bubble Tanks. Much like its predecessor, Bubble Tanks 2 is an open world top-down fighting game where you control a battle tank made of bubbles (hence the name Bubble Tank) and fight other Bubble Tanks to become stronger by collecting the bubbles they drop when defeated.

422622.overview:
The Blocks Cometh is an action game by Halfbot and published by Kongregate on October 30, 2010.

The world is crumbling around you and your only chance for survival is to climb.

422623.overview: Bubble Trouble or Bubble Struggle is a Pang variant. Like in Pang the player needs to shoot the bubbles until all the bubbles disappear and after that the next level begins. Sometimes when the the player shoots a bubble, an item will appear to help the player (e.g. more score and other weapons, like shots that stay for a few seconds or until a bubble is hit by it). If a bubble hist the player he will loses one life. The game is timed, and if the time runs out before the player destroys all the bubbles, he will also lose one life. There is an option to play in two-player mode.

422624.overview:
Battalion: Nemesis puts you in command of the Rapid Attack and Response unit commanded by Sergeant Tucker. Face off against the insidious Mullen in an epic 10 level campaign!

There are a total of 16 levels to be played, where you can master the rules of tactical turn-based strategy combat.

Saving Information:
Your inter-level mission progress will be saved when you finish a level. If you beat a level, you should not need to beat it again. Choosing “Save and Quit” from the options menu in the middle of the mission will create a restore point. If you click on “Resume Save Point” on the title screen, the game will be restored to that save point. If you play a game on a different level or map, your resume point will be lost.

422625.overview:
Hold the line against hundreds of pixelated monsters.

A hyper fast strategy / action game where you throw swarms of knights, spearmen, and mages against hordes of bad dudes.

422626.overview: Bowman 2 is a game created by Ephinx' where the player plays as a stickfigure with a bow and arrow, shooting various targets. The game features 3 different game modes, "Vs Human", "Vs Computer", and "Bird Hunting". The game is mildly violent, featuring copious amounts of blood, and so may not be suitable for younger players.

422628.overview:
Boxhead: A Halloween Special is the first game in the series. The town of Boxville is overrun with zombies. You must use your weapon(s) to drive back the zombies while leading a group of civilians to safety before time runs out.

You use your arrow keys to move about and press space to fire a weapon. You must lead a specific number of civilians to a safety zone before the timer runs out or you are gotten by a zombie. As the game progresses, you get better weapons and will need to rescue more civilians or will have a shorter time to accomplish your task. Be careful as the civilians will wander away or run off. There is an unlimited supply of zombies and civilians so you will always have the minimum number of civilians to rescue.

422630.overview:
During a peaceful shopping session, Burrito Bison was kidnapped by gummy bears and forced to wrestle. The only way home is through three giant gates of Candy Land.

At the start the player chooses an angle and launches Bison into the air. Without the speed he won't be able to escape, so bounce at bears to maintain it. Rocket pants will help to fall faster, but they have charges, gained by various actions. Also, dead gummies drop money, which can be spent for upgrades after every run, increasing Bison's attributes and chances to meet certain enemy types. The enemies are divided into harmful cops, who should be avoided, and helpful ones, gaining speed via explosions or minigames (i.e. click button as fast as possible or at right timing).

The game features 8 Newgrounds medals to unlock.

422632.overview:
In Body Ladder, the player takes control of a 3-D stick figure in a top hat who has only one goal, to reach the top of the level by stacking the dead bodies of an endless supply of evil clones.

The player uses four different melee weapons: a baseball bat, an axe, a chainsaw and dual pistols to destroy these clones which are unlocked once a level of bodies reach a certain point that is designated on the left side of the screen on a meter, however once the player unlocks a weapon they can't go back to the previous weapon. There is also five grenades at their disposal and their psychic powers which can explode the head of a clone.

There are also two powerups which drops down at random times: a health icon which is represented by a red cross and an icon called "psy" which induces a temporary cloak of invincibility. There is also two meters at the top of the screen, a health meter which is reduced each time the player is attacked and a "psy" meter with a number which represents who many head exploding attacks they can use, which is replenished over time.

The gameplay utilizes both the mouse and the keyboard, while the keyboard arrows are used for movement (Up is for jumping, left and right are to move) and the mouse is used for attack clones (maneuvering the cross hairs on the screen at a clone and clicking the left mouse button to use an attack). Depending on where the players aims their cross hair will determine which attack will be used (aiming anywhere on the lower body will have the player use a melee weapon and pointing it at the head will use the psy power to explode the clones head). Also the down button on the keyboard and the "S" button is used to throw a grenade.

422634.overview:
Bejeweled Twist is a tile matching game, where the player rotates groups of four jewels to create rows and columns of three or more matching gems. In the Classic and Zen modes, the objective is to make enough matches to fill a tube at the left side of the screen to move to the next level. There's a chain meter at the top of this tube, that builds up with matches in a row multiplying the points, and making a fruit jewel appear when full. A box at the tube bottom shows the sequence of matches needed for bonus points.

Obstacles appear randomly on the game board. The coal can't be matched, but it can be exploded by one of the power-ups gems. The locked jewel is chained to its place and can't move, but it can be removed with a match. Bomb gems display the number of moves allowed before they explode, destroying the board and ending the game. They have to be matched before their counters reach zero, otherwise a revolving wheel-of-fortune appears that stops in one of two values, skulls or gems, that either detonate or disarm the bomb. This mini-game becomes more difficult every time it comes up.

The power-ups appear after making matches of four or more gems. A four jewel match creates the flame gem, that explodes when matched removing all surrounding jewels. A five jewel match creates the lightning gem, that destroys a column and a row at the same time in a cross of fire.

With the exception of Classic Mode, the other modes are unlocked with continuous playing. Zen Mode is similar to Classic, but is more relaxed without the bomb and locked jewels. Challenge Mode is a puzzle mode, where the objective is to perform a task, like removing all gems of one color, or making a number of matches in a row. In Blitz Mode, the goal is to accumulate the maximum amount of points possible within a time limit.

422638.overview:
Bionic Chainsaw Pogo Gorilla is an action game developed by Roger Barr.

This game tells the story of a gorilla who is kidnapped from the wild by scientists who dare to answer that age-old question: "What would happen if you removed a gorilla's arms and replaced them with chainsaws, and you removed its legs and replaced them with a pogo stick?"

422639.overview: Bitejacker is a zombie video game created by Secret Base.

422640.overview: Bubble Spinner is a match-3 bubble shooter game with a twist. The bubbles are attached to a spinner that rotates when you fire bubbles at it. This adds a dimension of creativity to the gameplay that requires a different approach.

422642.overview: Matrix Bullet Time Fighting, simply known as BulletTime Fighting, is a stick figure action Flash game developed by Dennis Gid and published on Stickpage. In this game, the player can fight in bullet time, run up walls, and fight against up to five enemies at the same time in Matrix-style.

422643.overview:
In Bush Shoot-Out, the player takes control of George W. Bush and a brief stint as Condoleezza Rice as a group of terrorists have invaded the White House. There are three levels in all: Oval Office, Cross Hall, Escape. Besides the Oval Office, the other levels have two different chapters: you play as both George Bush in the beginning of the Cross Hall and Condoleezza in the second while in Escape you play switch to a first-person view before heading outside to battle enemy helicopters and a suicide bomber van.

The gameplay consists of hiding behind a stationary object for each stage, using the mouse to pop up by moving up and ducking by moving down. To fire the player clicks the mouse button while using the "R" button to manually reload.

422645.overview: Big Pixel Racing is a pixelated racing game developed by BigPixel and published on Kongregate on December 21, 2009.

422646.overview:
Bloxorz is an innovative puzzle game, where you must navigate a block to the exit.

Your block consists of two cubes and can move it around by tilting it. When tilted upright it occupies one tile, when laid down on its side it occupies two tiles. The goal is to drop the block upright into the square hole. Game mechanics are simple, but some of the stages are pretty hard.

Additional gameplay elements make things a bit more interesting. There are orange tiles which can not support too much weight, if you stand on them in the upright position you fall through. There are bridges that open or close when pushing a button. There are O-switches and X-switches. O-switches are triggered no matter how you roll onto them, X-switches are only triggered when you roll onto them upright. Teleporter switches split your block up into two cubes, which you can then move separately.

There are 33 stages and passcode system to continue a stage at a later time.

422647.overview:
Bowmaster Prelude is a strategy game where you fight an evil force known as The Trev' Gahr with the help of your magical bow and peasants of your kingdown willing to fight for their lost loved ones.

You start the game in your castle from which you can shoot enemies from. To win, you must either kill all enemies and end the wave or capture the enemy flag. The player can't capture the flag, you must help your allied units do it for you. You lose if the enemy is able to capture your own flag, or if you die.

There are 4 different modes to choose freely in the options menu for using the bow:

The first and default one is the pull string method, where you have to pull the arrow backwards and release it to fire. The more you pull, the more force is applied on the arrow and more it will fly through the air. You must account for gravity when using this method. The second method is the auto aim. You only have to point at your target and the arrow will fly there, automatically accounting for gravity. It already shoots with the strongest force, but that can be changed. You can also change whether it will fire arrows in low angles or high angles with the buttons L and H. The third method is the point aim. Very similar to auto aim, however it doesn't account for gravity; Instead, it points directly to where you aim. The fourth method is the drag anywhere. Very similar to pull string, however you can pull the arrow from anywhere in the screen instead of having to click on the back of the arrow, making it easier to shoot repeatedly with it.

After winning a level, you get an amount of gold based on your performance. There are different types of arrows and allied units to buy after finishing a level, all of which are saved forever and don't have to rebought after each level, as long as you don't override the game's saves. Special enemies also come on later levels.

422680.overview: Back to the Cubeture is a game in the Cuboy series.  In this adventure, Cuboy is sent through space and time, and must make his way back home by traversing through a world of weirdness.

422697.overview:
CLOP is a sequel to QWOP, but I guess you could also say it was inspired by Kikstart II. Your task is simply to run over a small hill.

This game works weird. In order for it to recognize your key input, click away and then click back.

423002.overview:
Bejeweled 2 is the enhanced, standalone version of the free online puzzle game of similar name. It builds on the original award-winning game, with the same basic objective of matching "jewels" in a grid by threes, by swapping adjacent jewels of different colors. Sharper graphics and more special effects improve the experience.

Also new to Bejeweled 2 are different play modes. There are "Classic" (no time limit, finite possible moves), "Action" (time limit, infinite moves), and "Endless" (no time limit, infinite moves) just for passing the time. Each mode has increasingly difficult levels. An additional "Puzzle" mode challenges the player with over 50 preset arrangements.

Bejeweled Blitz, the 60 second mode with unique power-ups, was also later added to the iPhone release of the game, where a player's score can then be uploaded to Facebook to compare with friends.

443911.overview: Play AdventureQuest to explore an online RPG and other games for free. New adventures every week.

448069.overview:
Bookworm is a combination of Scrabble and Bejeweled, in which you create words by selecting letters from adjacent tiles. Completed words are converted to points and removed from the board. New tiles fall in from the top to fill in the empty tile positions. Watch out for fiery letter tiles that will burn through your other tiles one at a time. Creating longer words will stave off burning tiles and generate bonus tiles as well. Words containing bonus tiles are worth more points.

The dictionary in this deluxe version is robust, containing over 150,000 words from three to twelve letters long.

451332.overview: The Right Mix is a promotional browser game made for web design company Liquid Light and development company Land Securities from the United Kingdom. The game is about creating your own cocktails without causing a disaster. There is around 22 kinds of create-your-own-alcohol-drinks and you are awarded points for each successful recipe. The more complex the more points earned. The game end when your barman faints.

451745.overview: Bejeweled is a tile match-3 game developed and published by PopCap Games. It is the first game in the Bejeweled series, and the first game to be published by PopCap under their current name. Bejeweled involves lining up 3 or more gems of the same color in a row to clear them from the board, to score enough points to reach the next level.

451747.overview:
Bookworm Adventures follows the tale of a little green worm named Lex (of the original Bookworm game) throughout 3 themed books as he spells words to defeat evil monsters. The main game interface is a 4x4 grid of letters, and unlike in the original Bookworm game, the letters do not need to connect to form words. The game is turn-based, and after the user attacks their opponent, the opponent then takes its turn. Each book is divided into 10 chapters that culminate in a "boss battle" in which the player is rewarded with a treasure upon defeating the enemy. Treasures do many things, ranging from increasing damage for using certain letters, to stunning the enemy, and a whole lot more. A player can only choose 3 treasures to bring with them into a chapter (out of an eventual total of 31).

The game is part RPG, part word game. Eventually, the player will find that enemies can cause status ailments such as poison, bleeding, burning, stun, petrification, etc. These range from causing damage over time, to loss of a turn, to weakening their attacks. Through the use of certain treasures, items and special gem tiles, the player can cause similar inflictions to the enemy. In addition, after defeating a monster the player is awarded experience points, which will lead to a level up which imparts a bonus of either extra health, attack power increase, or defensive ability increased.

The player is rewarded with gem tiles for spelling words of longer length (and also by using certain treasures which increase their frequency of appearance). Enemies will also sometimes drop potions. Health potions refill the user's health meter, attack potions increase their attack power by 50% and purify potions clear the player and tile grid of all status ailments.

The game also includes an Arena mode (unlocked after completing all 3 books) in which the player can fight in real-time against all the bosses of the game. Every 5 opponents, the player is awarded one of each potion type and is allowed to change the 3 treasures they have equipped. Players are rewarded for spelling lots of short words quickly, attacking first, attacking many times before an enemy gets an attack in, defeating the opponent in 1-3 turns, and more. The more of these awards the player gets, the more bonus experience points they gain.

451907.overview:
Bejeweled 3 returns to the traditional match three formula after the slightly different spin off Bejeweled Twist. As in previous games, the player is presented with a board filled with gems of different colours. The aim of the game is to remove gems from the board by swapping adjacent gems so that a chain of three or more gems is created. New gems will then be generated at the top of the screen and fall down in the empty spaces. This can lead to a chain reaction when gems fall down and create new matches. New in Bejeweled 3 is that the player can continue swapping gems during a chain reaction. There are some special gems; flame gems are created from a match of four gems and explode when matched, thereby removing surrounding gems. A match of five gems will create a hypercube which can be matched with any adjacent gem and then destroy all gems of that colour. Star gems are created by T- or L-shaped matches and destroy all gems that are right, left, up and down of the it.

The game has four game modes: classic, zen, lightning, and quest. Classic is the original concept known from previous games. It is untimed and ends when no further moves are possible. The zen mode is meant for relaxation and has no end. Here the player can turn on various audio-visual effects. These are breath modulation, ambient sounds, mantras and binaural beats. Lightning is a timed mode and ends when the time is out. The standard time is one minute but by matching special time gems more time is added. The quest mode consists of a number of challenges. The player has to activate relics and each challenge corresponds to a relic.

There are also four additional secret modes that are extended versions of quest mode challenges. These are poker, butterflies, ice storm, and diamond mine. In poker mode, the player has to make poker hands with gem matches. For example, two of a gem type is a pair. The butterflies mode has special butterfly gems that move up from the bottom. These have to be matched before they reach the top. In the ice storm mode, ice moves up the board and the player has to make matches to knock it down again. In the diamond mine mode the lower part of the playing field is filled with rocks. The player has to dig through it by matching gems that are adjacent to it. By doing so gold coins, artifacts and diamonds can be mined from the rock.

The browser version is made using HTML5 and runs through Google's Native Client. Unlike the original 2000 browser version that served as a trial for the full Windows Bejeweled game, this is a complete release made available for free. There are two graphics modes, for faster and slower machines. It has only two game modes however, classic and speed (the latter identical to lightning), with the same power-ups.

453268.overview:
Battle Gear is a war strategy game developed by Belugerin Games and released on December 17, 2008.
Although Flash was discontinued on January 12 2021, Battle Gear is still playable through BlueMaxima’s Flashpoint.

Controls
Left arrow or A key to scroll left
Right arrow or D key to scroll right
Z or Y key to fast scroll to the left
X key to fast scroll to the centre
C key to fast scroll to the right
Left mouse click to navigate menus and train units
Number keys to train units quickly
P key to pause game

Gameplay
In Battle Gear, the player’s main objective, whether they are playing through one of the campaigns or are playing a custom match, is to win the battle by either destroying the enemy base or killing all enemy units on the battlefield. The player will lose a battle if they themselves run out of units or their base gets destroyed. The main part of the game is the multiple campaigns in which the player controls the army of a specific nation and must invade and overtake nearby regions.

Before the player begins each battle, in the menu they can view a “briefing” in order to be best informed on what strategies and units to utilise in the upcoming battle as different terrain and biomes and affect various unit types in both positive and negative ways. In-between battles, the player has the opportunity to upgrade their units stats and power skills as well as purchase new unit types to use in their army. These upgrades are purchase using XP earnt in battles; this XP will be spent however, so it is more akin to a currency.

Troop Deployment Modes
Random: No formation is made, troops will appear in random locations.
Manual: Troops will deploy in an arrow sign formation, can be controlled by clicking W & S or the up and down arrow keys.
Defense: Forms a massive wall of troops, deploys after at least 12 units are in the centre of the battlefield.
Offence: Troops will attack aggressively.
Battle Types
Infantry, Artillery, Air Force Battle (Land Battle): The player can only train one troop of every type of infantry, artillery and air force. The player cannot train another unit of the same type until the first unit has finished training.
All Infantry Battle (Land Battle): The player can train all types of infantry units and super parachute at the same time.
All Artillery Battle (Land Battle): The player can train all types of artillery units and super tank at the same time.
Infantry and Air Force Battle (Land Battle, Beach): The player can only train one troop of every type of infantry and air force. The player cannot train another unit of the same type until the first unit has finished training.
All Navy Battle (Sea/Naval Battle): The player can train all types of navy units and super speedboat at the same time.
Air Force and Navy Battle (Sea/Naval Battle): The player can only train one troop of every type of air force and navy. The player cannot train another unit of the same type until the first unit has finished training.

453276.overview:
Savage Pursuit is an online game available on Cartoon Network's website. Its original name is Savage Pursuit . On Cartoon Network's website it is listed as the " Ben 10: Race Against Time Movie Game " Animated Ben Tennyson appears as Graham Phillips

Plot
You have to defeat Dr. Animo (You are Ben ) but to defeat him you have to destroy his mutant animals (mostly rodents) and then against the Dinosaur he created in the episode " Learning to be a hero " to save Max and Gwen . You can only transform into four aliens: Cannonbolt , Heatblast , Beast and Wildvine and defeat all of their beasts.

The stranger you use
 
Cannonbolt : It seems to be the most powerful because it rolls very fast and destroys enemies. Its weakness is that when it is in ball form you lose a lot of Omnitrix time . In mined areas you can use it to roll and not lose life.

Fire : Shoots fire and jumps high. But his weakness is going over waterfalls.

Beast : Detects hidden bombs and jumps high. If he reaches an enemy while jumping, he scratches them. The weakness is that he takes a long time to jump and only attacks when he jumps.

Wildvine : Shoots balls and when there is a branch, it can grab onto it and go from branch to branch. Its weakness is that it cannot jump and it is somewhat slow when walking.

Keys

Z : You transform by holding down:

. Up arrow: You transform into Fire .

· Down arrow: You transform into a Beast .

· Right arrow: You transform into Cannonbolt .

· Left arrow: You transform into Wildvine .

453548.overview:
The follow-up to the hugely succesful Battle Gear strategic warfare game by Belugerin Studios.

Your goal is once again to conquer the world. One of the developments in this follow-up is the introduction of alliances (USA, Europe, China, Russia, Australia, Africa, Middle East and Indonesia) which you can control to attack various parts of the world.



Instructions
Choose your alliance and conquer the world.

During battle:
[Left/Right arrows] or [A]/[D] to scroll the field.
Press [Z], [X] and [C] keys to fast scroll to the left, center and right edge of battlefield.
Click units to train or use [1..9] hotkeys.
Press [P] to pause the game

453705.overview:
Another version of Battle Gear strategy. Your objectives are to destory the enemy base or enemy unit is zero. You will lose if your base is destroyed or your unit is zero. Click on a unit to train and attack the enemy. Create a new unit by clicking the unit type.
Use LEFT/RIGHT or A,D keys to scroll the game. You can also use your mouse.

453880.overview: In the strategic warfare game Battle Gear: All Defense it is your duty to select your battlke and fight against your opponents with various troops on land or at sea.

453919.overview: Battle Gear Portal War is a game where you pull out the troops through the portal and platform. Here you will set the strategy to put the troops in the right place in order to destroy the enemy base, check the position of the portal so that you don't get stuck into the blackhole. Be the master of portal land and conquer all enemies!

453938.overview:
Battle Gear Missile Attack is a strategy defense game developed by Belugerin Studios. Libya is under attack! Send out the best missiles on the Libya territory and win all waves in this epic wars!
This game is played with mouse only.

454024.overview: Battle Gear is back in underground landscape and a platform strategy war game. Unleash units in four rows, mobilize infantry, artillery and air force units, launch air strikes, place advanced tower defense units, add units with supported skills to becomes more powerful, jump over ground platform, destroy enemy base, unlock all medals and complete 40 levels by playing 4 different paths, there will be a different battlefield at each level.

472631.overview:
Black Ops Korean Conflict is an action-adventure game set in a fictional scenario where North Korea conducts nuclear tests despite international warnings, prompting a covert mission to prevent escalation into a larger conflict or potential WW3
. Players assume the role of a black-ops special forces ninja operative assigned by an unknown government to eliminate threats and destroy nuclear capabilities

482464.overview: A short comic Henry Stickmin adventure about trying to break into a bank. Choose between several absurd plans and watch their successes or spectacularly unsuccessful outcomes.

482492.overview: The first Bloons Tower Defense game, in which defensive towers are placed along the balloons' route. Spend earned money on more monkeys and upgrades to stop each successive wave.

482502.overview: An arcade action game about a barbarian facing endless hordes of orcs. Move and slash to survive as long as possible while the enemies grow stronger and arrive in greater numbers.
